name: Offshore platform electrification (power from shore, offshore wind)
aliases: Offshore platform electrification (power from shore, offshore wind)
principle: Platforms take electricity from shore or from offshore wind instead of burning gas on site. Johan Sverdrup runs on hydro power from shore at about 0.67 kg CO2 per barrel against a world average of 15 kg, and Hywind Tampen's 94.6 MW meets about 35% of five platforms' demand.

process_steps.name: Supply power from shore cable or floating wind
